note: Two seconds per damage stage. The client game data as extracted by RoyaleAPI (last updated 18 October 2023) gives InfernoDragon variable_damage_time1 2000 and variable_damage_time2 2000 (ms), and the card page says the damage goes up a stage every two seconds until stage 3, with the optimal stun at 4 seconds; no balance entry changes the stage time. ClashStrategic cs2.4.0 gives every ramp record 1.5, the Monk's non-timed Deflect combo included. https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Inferno_Dragon https://github.com/RoyaleAPI/cr-api-data/blob/master/docs/json/cards_stats.json

The evolution keeps the base beam's first three stages (Beam Momentum only retains the charge and adds a fourth stage after 20 seconds), so its stage time is the base card's two seconds. https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Inferno_Dragon/Evolution

Two seconds per damage stage: the card page gives 5% of the maximum damage for the first two seconds and 18.75% in the next two, and the client game data as extracted by RoyaleAPI gives InfernoTower variable_damage_time1 2000 and variable_damage_time2 2000 (ms); no balance entry changes the stage time. https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Inferno_Tower https://github.com/RoyaleAPI/cr-api-data/blob/master/docs/json/cards_stats.json

Two seconds per damage stage: the Balance Update of 8 January 2025 decreased the time required to change stages to 2 seconds (from 2.25, set on 8 August 2023, seventeen months earlier; RoyaleAPI's extraction, last updated 18 October 2023, still carries the 2250 ms of that period). https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Mighty_Miner
